intro: The dig site is chaos. Between you and the landing pad: a mob of Boyz, and behind them, a Nob with a very big choppa.

victory_broken.text: Grizzgut staggers back, bleeding and furious. 'DIS AIN'T OVER, STUNTY!' He flees into the smoke, and the path to your ship is clear.

victory_negotiated.text: Grizzgut squints at you, then at the tunnels. 'Bigger fight dat way? ...Fine. But I'm comin' back for ya.' He stomps off, and his Boyz follow.

defeat.text: The world goes dark. You wake on your own deck, Dorrik's iron hand on your shoulder. 'Dragged you out myself. Don't make a habit of it.'

withdrew.text: You fall back.

intro: An Ork raider swings across your bow, guns glowing. It is ugly, slow, and absolutely covered in weapons.

victory_broken.text: The raider's engines cough and die in a gout of black smoke. You don't stay to loot it. You burn hard for open space.

defeat.text: Your ship is crippled, venting air and spinning. The raider loses interest and turns back to the burning world. Dorrik patches the worst of it, at a cost.

withdrew.text: You break away.

intro: The Ork scout spots you and tries to bolt. It is fast, lightly armed, and carrying exactly what you need.

victory_broken.text: The scout spins out of control. You latch on, and Dorrik pulls its nav-cogitator out by the roots.

defeat.text: The scout guns you down and escapes. You limp back, but Ylsa caught its heading before it vanished.

withdrew.text: You break off. Ylsa caught enough of its heading to piece the route together.

intro: Grots are picking the vault clean. They have cutting torches, a lot of stolen tools, and no idea how to use either.

victory_broken.text: The grots flee squealing, dropping armfuls of looted vault plates.

victory_negotiated.text: The grot boss trades you the vault plates for a tin of ration bars. 'Pleasure doin' bizness, stunty!'

defeat.text: The grots swarm you and make off with your tools. They leave the vault plates behind. Grots can't read.

withdrew.text: You back out and take rubbings from the outer walls instead. Not ideal, but readable.

intro: The prison hulk stinks of rust and fungus. Somewhere ahead, past the jailers, Hrolla is shouting at someone.

victory_broken.text: Krugrot goes down hard. You find Hrolla in the last cell, chained, bloody, and grinning. 'Took your time, Captain.'

victory_negotiated.text: Krugrot decides the stunty isn't worth dying for. 'Take 'er. She bites.' Hrolla limps out on her own feet.

defeat.text: You're thrown out of an airlock and picked up by your own crew. Hrolla is still in there. The hulk will be on alert now.

withdrew.text: You pull back before the whole hulk wakes up. Hrolla is still in there.

intro: The freebooter cutter that has been bleeding Kharr's convoys turns to meet you, gun ports open.

victory_broken.text: The cutter limps away trailing fire. Kharr will hear who did it.

defeat.text: The cutter mauls you and escapes. Kharr is unimpressed, but notes that you tried.

withdrew.text: You break off. The cutter is still out there, and Kharr knows it.

intro: The warband has dug in around a captured mining station. The Kin miners are barricaded in the ore silos.

victory_broken.text: Zogbad and his boyz flee to their bikes. The miners come out of the silos cheering.

defeat.text: The warband drives you off. The miners hold out without you, barely.

withdrew.text: You pull back. The warband stays.

intro: The camp is a ring of welded scrap around pits full of Kin prisoners. There are guards everywhere.

victory_broken.text: Gutrip falls. You break the chains one by one. A broad miner named Brokka picks up a hammer and says, 'I'm coming with you.'

victory_negotiated.text: Gutrip sells you the whole pit for a promise you have no intention of keeping. Brokka spits at him on the way out, then joins your crew.

defeat.text: Your crew drags you out of the camp. A handful of prisoners escape in the confusion.

withdrew.text: You retreat. A few prisoners slip out with you.

intro: The pit gates slam. First Grizzgut, back again and bigger. Then the champion. The crowd wants blood, and they don't much care whose.

victory_broken.text: Bonecrusha topples. The pit goes silent, then erupts. They are chanting your name. Badly, but it is your name. An old Kin prisoner presses a hammer into your hands as you leave: "It was my grandfather's."

victory_negotiated.text: You talk the champion into a draw in front of the whole warband. No Ork has ever seen anything like it. They will tell this story for years.

defeat.text: You go down in the dust, but you went down fighting. The Orks respect that more than you expected.

withdrew.text: There is no leaving the pit.

intro: Grapples clang onto your hull. Pirates are cutting through the cargo airlock.

victory_broken.text: The pirates flee back to their ship, leaving a few crates behind.

victory_negotiated.text: You convince the pirates that your cargo is mostly rocks. It is. They leave.

defeat.text: The pirates help themselves to your hold and leave you tied to a stanchion.

withdrew.text: You seal the bulkheads and wait them out.

intro: An Ork loota ship drops out of the dark, guns first. It doesn't want you. It wants your parts.

victory_broken.text: The lootas go dark. You strip what you can before the wreck drifts away.

defeat.text: The lootas strip some plating off your hull and roar away, delighted.

withdrew.text: You burn away and lose them in the dark.

intro: There she is: the freebooter cutter from Karrak's bounty board, lurking in the belt.

victory_broken.text: The cutter strikes its colours. Karrak will pay.

defeat.text: The cutter gets away. Karrak won't pay for a ship you didn't catch.

withdrew.text: You let her go. Karrak won't pay for a ship you didn't catch.

intro: The first wave comes in fast and ragged: a pack of escorts, guns blazing at anything that moves.

modifiers.text: First strike! Your guns open up before they see you coming.

victory_broken.text: The escort pack breaks apart, burning. The rest of the Ork fleet comes on behind it.

defeat.text: Your ship spins out of the line, crippled. The battle goes on without you.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: Behind the escorts comes Gitzbolt's gunship, glowing with stolen ancestor-light. Its great gun swings toward the Kin line.

modifiers.text: First strike! Your guns open up before they see you coming.

victory_broken.text: You leave the gunship dark and drifting. A tiny escape pod spits out of her belly and tumbles away into the fight.

defeat.text: The gunship's beam catches you square. Your ship drifts out of the fight, burning.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: The gunship's corridors hum with stolen power. Grots scatter ahead of you, and somewhere deeper in, Gitzbolt is shouting at a machine.

victory_broken.text: Gitzbolt flees down an access shaft, howling. In the heart of his machine sits the Ancestor Core, dormant and unharmed.

victory_negotiated.text: You promise Gitzbolt something shinier. He does not believe you, but he takes the deal anyway, and the Core with it is yours.

defeat.text: You wake on the deck of your own ship. Your crew dragged you out. Gitzbolt escaped with the Core.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: Skragnak's Kill Kroozer looms out of the smoke, guarded by its heaviest escort. Break the guard, and the flagship is open to boarding.

modifiers.text: First strike! Your guns open up before they see you coming.
Urgrot's ships turn their guns on Skragnak's guard!

victory_broken.text: The guard ship lists away, gutted. Nothing stands between you and the flagship now.

defeat.text: The Kroozer's guns tear into you. Your ship falls out of the line.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: The boarding tube punches through the Kroozer's hull. On the far side: noise, smoke, and a corridor full of very big Orks.

modifiers.text: A desperate strike: the battle is lost, and everyone knows it.
Dorrik is at your shoulder, true to his vow.

victory_broken.text: The 'Ard Boyz break and run for the gun decks. The way to the throne room is open.

defeat.text: They beat you back to the boarding tube. You push through anyway, bleeding, but the cost is paid elsewhere: the Orks keep burning the Hold's outer settlements while you fight.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: The Orks clear a circle. Grizzgut steps into it, bigger than ever, and points his choppa at you. This one is personal.

modifiers.text: You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: Grizzgut goes down and stays down. "Fine," he wheezes from the deck. "FINE. You win. Again."

defeat.text: Grizzgut stands over you, roaring his triumph. Then he gets bored and wanders off to find someone else to hit. You crawl on.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: You call the challenge in front of the whole warband. Skragnak laughs, throws down his gun, and steps into the circle. "FINALLY. A PROPER FIGHT."

modifiers.text: You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: Skragnak falls to one knee in front of his Boyz. The warband goes silent. Every Ork on the ship has just seen their Warboss beaten by a stunty.

defeat.text: The klaw comes down and the world goes white.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: Urgrot is already at Skragnak's throat when you burst into the throne room. "OI, STUNTY! HOLD 'IM STILL!"

modifiers.text: Urgrot is fighting at your side
You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: Between the two of you, Skragnak goes down. Urgrot plants a boot on his chest and roars. Half the warband roars back.

defeat.text: The klaw comes down and the world goes white.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: Skragnak's armour dies with the Core. He tears off a dead power klaw and comes at you with his bare green fists.

modifiers.text: You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: Without his big gun and his glowing armour, Skragnak is just a big Ork. You break him, and his Boyz watch it happen.

defeat.text: The klaw comes down and the world goes white.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: You catch Skragnak on the muster field, half-armoured, his fleet not yet in the sky.

modifiers.text: You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: Skragnak breaks before his Waaagh! ever leaves the ground. The muster scatters in every direction.

defeat.text: The klaw comes down and the world goes white.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: No tricks, no allies, no plan. Just you, the Warboss, and his Meganobz between you.

modifiers.text: You are hurt and the plan is in pieces.

victory_broken.text: It takes everything you have. When Skragnak finally falls, you are not sure you can stand either.

defeat.text: The klaw comes down and the world goes white.

withdrew.text: There is no running from this.

intro: The gate opens and the warband pours out, Boyz first, their Nob roaring behind them.

victory_broken.text: The Nob breaks, and the rest of the warband runs for the belt.

defeat.text: The warband drives you back to your ship. They are cheering. It will not last.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.

intro: The raider comes in fast, going for the slowest builder ship.

victory_broken.text: The raider limps off into the rocks. The builders sail on.

defeat.text: The raider gets through and the builders scatter. You will have to gather them again.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.

intro: The grots come screaming out of the vault, with the Boyz lumbering behind them.

victory_broken.text: The squatters run for the hills. The Anvil is yours again.

victory_negotiated.text: The grots take a bag of shiny bolts and leave, dragging the Boyz with them.

defeat.text: The squatters hold the vault, for now.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.

intro: The loota ship lifts off the wreck field, every gun it owns pointed at you.

victory_broken.text: The lootas flee, leaving their pile of salvage behind.

defeat.text: The lootas drive you off. They are still in the tunnels.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.

intro: The gunship's guns light up, and so does every light in the Scrapfield.

victory_broken.text: The gunship slews sideways into the wreck, dead in the water. The workshop's hatch is right there.

defeat.text: The gunship drives you out of the Scrapfield. Gitzbolt's laughter follows you all the way out on the open channel.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.

intro: Grots pour out of every duct, and behind them, Gitzbolt lowers a welding mask and revs something that should not be revved.

victory_broken.text: Gitzbolt dives into an escape pod and is gone, again. But he left the Core behind.

victory_negotiated.text: You make Gitzbolt an offer he cannot refuse: leave now, and keep his teeth. He takes it. The Core stays.

defeat.text: You wake up outside the workshop. Gitzbolt has bolted the hatch and painted "GO AWAY" on it.

withdrew.text: You pull back to try again another day.
